purpose: Rate 评分; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandRate](../../lib/src/components/rate.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Committed value drives semantics and pop. Selection shape/eyes/paired outline switch atomically; hover preview remains separate. New stars pop1 to1.15 to1 over350ms with60ms stagger. Rejected proposals do not start committed celebration.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: A committed score and optional hover preview
scenarios.when: Increase, decrease, clear, traverse with Tab or use arrow/Home/End keys
scenarios.then: Only newly lit stars pop350ms with60ms delays; only the last new star splashes600ms. Hover/color/eye transitions250ms. One selected-or-first Tab stop; Right/Up increase and Left/Down decrease the committed score without wrapping; same score does not dispatch. Keyboard and clear remove hover preview. Reduced motion settles immediately.
Group has radioGroup role; each checked action itself has mutually-exclusive flag. No flag-only wrapper separates the role from the checked action.

scenarios.given: Necessary content on its actual supporting surface, including reduced-motion changes
scenarios.when: Enter, sample intermediate frames, reverse/reopen, close, cancel and unmount
scenarios.then: Content/backing stay readable; one subtree retains state; hit/focus/semantics track availability; no stale timer or duplicate callback. Approved reference deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md.
